title: Buttons disappear and sometimes don't reappear - dev-i
symptom: The carbs, calculator, insulin, and treatments buttons disappear and sometimes don't reappear. In one instance, after the pump battery died, the buttons never reappeared, preventing the user from using the calculator to determine a manual dose.
cause: The buttons are hidden by design when they cannot be used, such as when the pump is not available. The code logic hides buttons based on conditions like profile selection and pump connectivity.
fix: No fix was provided; the behavior is by design. The developer explained the logic and suggested that making the calculator available when the pump is not available is a niche function that needs team discussion.
evidence_quote: By design, the buttons are only available when you can use them.
